hypothesis.statement: The validated ecology-v2 baseline passes the existing scientific suitability gate and survives freezing without a learner trial.
hypothesis.falsification: A missing factor or mismatched evidence passes, or the validated unchanged scenario fails after freezing.
hypothesis.rationale: Admission must cover hunger, safety and temperature under the same archived physical conditions.

decisionRule: Admission/freeze smoke only. Do not execute this study or infer learner results.
